traits.name: Amorphous
traits.description: The Midnight Essence can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide.

traits.name: Fear of Lightweaving
traits.description: If a character uses the Illumination surge while within 60 feet of the Midnight Essence, the Midnight Essence gains a disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.

traits.name: Immunities
traits.description: The Midnight Essence is immune to the Restrained condition.

actions.name: Uncanny Nature
actions.description: The Midnight Essence's mannerisms unsettle its foes. Each enemy within 5 feet of the Midnight Essence must succeed on a DC 14 Discipline test or lose 1 focus.

actions.name: Mimic Violence
actions.description: After a character the Midnight Essence can sense within 60 feet of it uses a free action or an action that costs no more than 1 action point, the Midnight Essence crudely copies the same action, choosing a new target if it wishes. The Midnight Essence must be able to reasonably shift its form to mimic any objects or forces essential to that action, it can't use an action requiring Investiture, and it must spend focus if required by that action.

strikes.name: Formed Weapon
strikes.on-hit: The Midnight Essence can spend 1 focus to inflict one of the following conditions on the target: Afflicted [1d8 damage of the same type], Disoriented, Prone, or Slowed.
strikes.description: Attack +9, reach 10 ft., one target. Graze: 4 (1d8) impact or keen damage. Hit: 16 (1d8 + 12) impact or keen damage, and the Midnight Essence can spend 1 focus to inflict one of the following conditions on the target: Afflicted [1d8 damage of the same type], Disoriented, Prone, or Slowed.
